clientIntent.summary: The client wants a warm, open, Scandinavian-inspired residence with strong daylight, low energy demand, natural materials, and a clear relationship to the landscape.
constraints: Total project cost should remain near the early target budget.
Interior spaces should feel open without excessive heat loss.
Material choices should support a natural visual style.

site.soilNote: Moderate bearing capacity. Deeper excavation should be reviewed by civil/structural consultants.

verifiedRules.exactText: Minimum front yard setback in the R-1 residential district shall be 20 feet from the front property line.
Minimum side yard setback in the R-1 residential district shall be 10 feet.
Principal structures in the R-1 residential district shall not exceed 35 feet in building height unless a variance is granted.
Projects demonstrating solar-ready roof area and passive design measures may qualify for expedited sustainability review.

designModel.name: Concept Massing V4
designModel.materialIntent: light timber, mineral plaster, triple-pane glazing

sunStudy.summary: Southwest orientation improves afternoon daylight but increases late-day heat gain risk.

ashrae.summary: Cooling demand increased after glazing expansion. Triple-pane glazing and exterior shading reduce modeled risk.

carbon.summary: Timber structure lowers embodied carbon compared with conventional steel framing in the demo assumptions.

integrations.purpose: Embodied-carbon factors, EPD/source links, product matching, and cost/performance data
